users.extensionHint: One extension per agent, used for every call. Internal calls are told apart by the internal numbers list in Settings.

settings.heading: System settings
settings.intro: Values the system reads while running. They take effect without a redeployment; the Agent App picks up the PBX host at the next sign-in.
settings.rejected: Nothing was saved - check the fields marked in red.

pbx.host.label: PBX host (SIP)
pbx.host.hint: The address the Agent Apps register to over the VPN. Leave blank if it is not known yet.

callback.extension.label: Call-back extension
callback.extension.hint: An extension the server uses for calls that never reached an agent.

pbx.ami.enabled.label: Enable AMI
pbx.ami.enabled.hint: Deferred with section 4.5 - has no effect yet.

agent.idle_logout_minutes.label: Automatic logout (minutes)
agent.idle_logout_minutes.hint: Laptops are shared between shifts, so the previous agent must not stay signed in.

agent.edit_window.label: Classification edit window
agent.edit_window.hint: How long an agent may edit the classification of their own calls.

sla.answer_seconds.label: Service level threshold (seconds)
sla.answer_seconds.hint: The percentage of calls answered within this time.

recording.retention_days.label: Recording retention (days)
recording.retention_days.hint: Recordings are deleted after this; the call record and classification remain.

reports.internal_numbers.label: Internal numbers
reports.internal_numbers.hint: The agents and branch extension numbers, comma separated. A call with one of these is recorded as usual but left out of the customer reports (S-48).

contacts.phoneHint: Any format: 059… or +97059… — the system treats them as one number.
